mapper.select: SELECT USR.U_IDX AS U_IDX, USR.U_ID AS U_ID, IFNULL(USR.U_C_IDX,0) AS U_C_IDX, USR.U_PASSWORD AS U_PASSWORD, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, USR.U_EMAIL AS U_EMAIL, USR.U_PHONE AS U_PHONE, USR.U_FILE AS U_FILE, DATE_FORMAT(USR.U_JOINDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS U_JOINDATE, USR.U_WITHDRAW AS U_WITHDRAW, USR.U_REVIEW AS U_REVIEW, USR.U_STATUS AS U_STATUS, IFNULL(COP.C_NAME, '새회사') AS C_NAME FROM USER AS USR LEFT JOIN COMPANY AS COP ON COP.C_IDX = USR.U_C_IDX WHERE U_IDX = #{U_IDX}

SELECT REW.R_IDX AS R_IDX, REW.R_C_IDX AS R_C_IDX, REW.R_U_IDX AS R_U_IDX, REW.R_STAR AS R_STAR, REW.R_TITLE AS R_TITLE, REW.R_CONTENT AS R_CONTENT, DATE_FORMAT(REW.R_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS R_DATE, CASE WHEN REW.R_WORK = 'CURRENT' THEN '현직원' WHEN REW.R_WORK = 'FORMER' THEN '전직원' END AS R_WORK, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, COP.C_NICNAME AS C_NICNAME, IFNULL(COP.C_NAME, '새회사') AS C_NAME, COP.C_LOGO AS C_LOGO FROM REVIEW AS REW INNER JOIN USER AS USR ON REW.R_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY AS COP ON COP.C_IDX = REW.R_C_IDX WHERE USR.U_IDX = #{u_idx} ORDER BY R_IDX DESC

SELECT U_REVIEW, IFNULL(C_IDX,0) AS C_IDX, IFNULL(C_NAME,'회사 확인중') AS C_NAME, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW RE WHERE RE.R_C_IDX = USR.U_C_IDX AND RE.R_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX ) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM USER AS USR LEFT JOIN COMPANY AS COP ON COP.C_IDX = USR.U_C_IDX WHERE U_IDX = #{u_idx}
